title: Christ the Redeemer
visualBrief: Complete individual medium-fi Christ the Redeemer monument and integral octagonal chapel pedestal:long draped robe with lower vertical pleats and original asymmetric mantle/chest folds,closed head/face/neck and hair,extended closed sleeves,palms/fingers/thumbs,paired feet,beveled dark pedestal coping andclosed approximate rear chapel door. Surrounding viewing terraces,railings,stairs,lifts,station,restaurants andmountain remain native context;no copied inscription orinterior.
nativeAxes: +X NNW along the arms toward the statue left hand;+Z ENE across the front viewing terrace toward the bay;+Y up. Approximate signed picture/footway reconstruction,not surveyed azimuth.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: The original pedestal has an explicit Y=0 base plane above its closed buried foundation. Host terrain supplies the relative ground datum;exact summit grades remain approximate. Retained Wikidata facts give30.1m statue and8m pedestal;source top38.1m above the authored pedestal base. The standard global field center is528.95m andsmooths the sharp Corcovado summit;native peak POI710m remains a separate fact. No fabricated mountain orsite survey.
